headline: Global Crude Oil Refinery Inputs Fell 6% in Q2 2026 Amid Middle East Conflict
summary: Global crude oil refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day in the second quarter of 2026 following the start of conflict in the Middle East. Throughput later increased by 1.8 million barrels per day in the third quarter.
why: Global refinery throughput data provides critical visibility into petroleum product supply, refining margins, and crude demand trends across international energy markets.
why_moved: A sharp drop in refinery inputs reduces immediate physical demand for crude oil processing, while subsequent recovery points to shifting trade flows following regional conflict.
